extensions.name: uBlock Origin Lite
extensions.description: An experimental, declarative Manifest V3 content blocker built for speed and minimal memory footprint. Filters ads, trackers, and malware domains locally with zero remote code execution.
extensions.author: gorhill

extensions.name: Refined GitHub
extensions.tagline: Simplifies the GitHub interface and adds useful features.
extensions.description: Adds over 200 quality-of-life improvements to GitHub: reaction avatars, clickable file paths, branch diff shortcuts, whitespace toggles, and cleaner PR review workflows.
extensions.author: refined-github

extensions.name: Dark Reader
extensions.tagline: Dark mode for every website. Take care of your eyes.
extensions.description: Analyzes web pages in real time and generates balanced dark themes on the fly. Customize brightness, contrast, sepia filters, and per-site rules with complete source transparency.
extensions.author: darkreader

extensions.name: Bitwarden Password Manager
extensions.tagline: Secure, audited open-source password and passkey vault.
extensions.description: Zero-knowledge encrypted vault for passwords, TOTP authenticators, and passkeys. Independently security audited and compiled reproducibly from public GitHub sources.
extensions.author: bitwarden

extensions.name: Vimium C
extensions.tagline: Keyboard-driven browser navigation and tab control.
extensions.description: Navigate links, switch tabs, search history, and scroll pages without touching your mouse. Features customizable Vim keybindings and an instant omni-bar launcher.
extensions.author: gdh1995

extensions.name: SingleFile
extensions.tagline: Save a complete web page into a single self-contained HTML file.
extensions.description: Captures full web pages including CSS, images, fonts, and frames into one clean, offline-ready HTML file. Ideal for archiving documentation and research articles.
extensions.author: gildas-lormeau

extensions.name: JSON Formatter Open
extensions.tagline: Fast, zero-tracking syntax highlighter and tree viewer for JSON.
extensions.description: Automatically detects raw JSON responses in the browser and renders collapsible trees, clickable URLs, raw/parsed toggles, and dark mode support without external network calls.
extensions.author: callumlocke

extensions.name: SponsorBlock
extensions.tagline: Crowdsourced skipping of sponsors, intros, and reminders.
extensions.description: Automatically skips sponsor segments, subscription reminders, and non-music sections on videos using a privacy-preserving, community-submitted timestamp database.
extensions.author: ajayyy

extensions.name: Return YouTube Dislike
extensions.tagline: Restores dislike counts on video pages using community & archived data.
extensions.description: Brings back the dislike counter display on YouTube using a combination of archived statistics and real-time extension user votes, with complete source transparency.
extensions.author: Anarios

extensions.name: KeePassXC-Browser
extensions.tagline: Native local desktop database bridge for KeePassXC.
extensions.description: Connects your browser securely via Native Messaging to a local KeePassXC database file—keeping credentials offline and completely under your own file-system control.
extensions.author: keepassxreboot

extensions.name: OpenStacker
extensions.tagline: An open-source alternative to the infamous game called Stacker.
extensions.author: KazoonKa
